_contract_lint_selftest_note: The 11-file 'contract-lint' directory (malformed, unresolvable-ref, missing-ed, core-waived-by-ed, trailer-not-terminal, malformed-heading, core-waived-with-correct-duplicate, register-block-removed, core-no-enforcer, duplicate-block-id, duplicate-register-row — each a .md fixture + a documenting .json descriptor) is contract-lint.js's OWN R1 negative self-test corpus (consumed directly by contract-lint.test.js). It is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from the count above and from conformance-matrix.js's fixture walker: those inputs are contract-shaped documents fed to contract-lint itself, not {input,expect} kernel-conformance cases evaluated against role-binding.json/support-matrix.json. Counting or executing them as kernel-conformance fixtures would conflate G0.1's self-test with G0.3's matrix conformance. (trailer-not-terminal added SP-20260718-001 Phase 0 gauntlet round 1 fix, S-1; malformed-heading + core-waived-with-correct-duplicate added gauntlet round 2, N-1/N-6; register-block-removed added gauntlet round 3, R3-4; core-no-enforcer + duplicate-block-id + duplicate-register-row added gauntlet round 4, R4-2/R4-4.)
_conformance_matrix_selftest_note: The 'conformance-matrix-selftest' directory (retention/bad-input-shape.json [N-2, gauntlet round 2] + role-binding/missing-required-field.json [R3-1, gauntlet round 3]) is conformance-matrix.js's OWN negative self-test corpus (consumed directly by conformance-matrix.test.js) -- excluded from the count above via EXCLUDED_GATE_DIRS, mirroring the contract-lint self-test exclusion. Its fixtures are DELIBERATELY shape-malformed -- bad-input-shape.json has a non-object 'input' (N-2); missing-required-field.json has a valid-but-empty 'input:{}' that passes N-2 but is missing its gate's own required field(s), e.g. role-binding's 'actor_kind' (R3-1) -- to prove loadFixtures() fails closed (exit 2) rather than silently evaluating a malformed/underspecified case and reading a coincidental green.
_trust_boundary_seed_note: C-2 [DISPOSITIONED, security-Claude, gauntlet round 1]: the 'trust-boundary' gate's evaluator (conformance-matrix.js GATE_EVALUATORS['trust-boundary']) only computes a BLOCK/PASS decision for the 'integrate_to_main' action -- ONE of CORE-2's four named powers (top-level-runtime-contract.md §1/§7 P7.2: capability grants, protected mutation, verification, integration-to-main). The other three powers are DEFINED by the contract but have no evaluator logic and always compute PASS against this seed. This is intentional Phase-0 scope, NOT a coverage gap: the CORE-2 invariant DEFINITION covers all four powers; the live enforcement MECHANISM for all four (the pinned trusted checker / atomic CAS integration principal) is RATIFIED-PLAN Phase-4 work (ED-215). Do not read core_coverage.CORE-2's single fixture as proof that capability-grants/protected-mutation/verification are themselves gated today -- they are not, until Phase 4 ships.
